fishing: WHEN: Wednesday evening Oct 7. Charlotte Harbor afternoon low about 4:51p, next high about 11:39p. Lemon Bay solunar high; major was about 9:54a-11:54a. NW 5-10 kt becoming SE, light chop, rain about 81%, numerous storms this evening — pass and Gulf legs already late. PASSES-BEACH: Fishin Franks 10/02 Placida/Gasparilla — mangrove snapper fewer but bigger, a few flounder and redfish, mostly dinky snook, a few sharks near Gasparilla Pass. Guides this week have redfish schools thick on the beach and flats with snook mixed in. LEMON BAY: Fishin Franks 10/02 docks and mangroves holding mangrove snapper, small black drum, redfish and snook; grassy areas a few trout. NEARSHORE: Fall school bite — redfish, snook, mangrove snapper and trout; some sharks as water cools. Capt. Mike / Manasota Key Outfitters last posted report still June; no October bite note. Baits: live shrimp, cut bait, pinfish, gold spoons, topwater on the reds.
redtide: FWC Oct 2: K. brevis background only in SWFL (Sarasota samples); Charlotte Harbor samples through Oct 5 background, none detected. No fish kills. Next report Oct 9.
bacteria: Manasota Key Beach GOOD, no advisory — enterococci 10 on 9/28 (Healthy Beaches, page updated 10/7). Englewood Beach GOOD, last listed 20 CFU, no advisory.
fpl: Evening check: Charlotte 2 / Sarasota 149 customers out; no Englewood/Manasota spike noted.
